settings.text:
§l§9Newb Aerotion v2.0§r

A Newb variant modified by Goboyy22.

Newb Aerotion will make your gaming experience more enjoyable, with a better appearance with vibrant nuances, beautiful skies, balanced coloring with a very beautiful sunset/sunrise sky.

Recommended Settings

Graphics: §aFancy§r
Smooth Lighting: §aON§r
Clouds: §aON§r
Brightness: §a50 - 90§r

§cNote: Clouds must be turned OFF when using Simple Graphics.§r
